    Donor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS receipt_count

  (repeat_amount::FLOAT / NULLIF(total_amount, 0)) * 100 AS percent_of_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS repeat_donor_count
